note: Every clip a committed provider-benchmark evidence file measured, with the licence it can be redistributed under. Both are synthetic and generated by this repository's own scripts, so they carry the project's MIT licence.

clips.origin: Synthetic 160x96 sixteen-frame fixture from the reference corpus's deterministic fixture generator; tests/clips/manifest.json records the same licence.
clips.role: Regression fixture driven with a fixed manual region. It proves which provider ran and that both lanes produce identical output. It does not measure inference throughput.

clips.origin: Synthetic 1280x720, 24 fps, twelve-second clip rendered by scripts/generate_benchmark_clip.py: a moving textured plate with four rendered captions. No third-party footage or fonts are embedded in the pixels beyond OpenCV's built-in Hershey font.
clips.role: Throughput clip driven with automatic detection, so OCR inference runs throughout the clip, on every frame pHash skipping doesn't reuse the previous mask for. Base a CPU-versus-CUDA download decision on this clip, not on the fixture.
